mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE increases by >0.3pp over one month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 1% month-over-month indicate broad consumer demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline >1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, rising industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 2% year-over-year signals strengthening corporate capacity utilization, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 2% YoY during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: Strong nonfarm payrolls growth (PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM) indicates robust labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 3.5% annualized signals persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 0.5% YoY indicate economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline >0.5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a federal funds rate above 4.5% signals restrictive policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as equity valuations adjust.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% during monetary tightening cycles.
